Abul Kalam Azad (Bachchu Razakar) Expelled Jamaat member Judgment: Death penalty Date of judgment: Jan 21, 2013 Status: absconding Appeal deadline: Feb 21

Abdul Quader Mollah Jamaat Assistant Secretary General Judgment: Life sentence Date of judgment: Feb 5, 2013 Status: Proceedings at Appellate Division

Delawar Hossain Sayedee Jamaat Nayeb-e-Ameer Judgment: Death sentence Date of judgment: Feb 28, 2013 Status: Appeal proceedings yet to start Expected completion: May 28/29

Muhammad Kamaruzzaman Jamaat Assistant Secretary General Judgement: Death sentence Date of judgement: May 9, 2013 Status: Appeal proceedings yet to start

Ghulam Azam Former Jamaat Ameer Judgement: 90 years prison Date of judgement: July 15, 2013 Status: 30 days to file appeal by both govt & defence
